title: Eigenvalues of a Triangular Matrix
prompt:
Find the eigenvalues of the triangular matrix:

    [[-6, 5], [0, -5]]

List them in increasing order (e.g. -1 3).
hint: the eigenvalues of a triangular matrix are its diagonal entries
recap: The eigenvalues of a triangular matrix are simply its diagonal entries. In general they are the roots of det(A − λI) = 0.
